integrations.name: Linq
integrations.description: Send and manage iMessage, RCS, and SMS conversations, attachments, phone numbers, payments, and webhooks through the Linq Partner API.

actions.name: Add Chat Participant
actions.description: Add an external participant to an existing group chat.

actions.name: Add Poll Options
actions.description: Irreversibly add recipient-visible options to an existing iMessage poll.

actions.name: Block Handle
actions.description: Block a handle account-wide from inbound and direct outbound messaging.

actions.name: Cancel Payment
actions.description: Irreversibly cancel a financial payment and close its virtual card.

actions.name: Cancel Payment Request
actions.description: Irreversibly cancel an unpaid payment request and its underlying payment intent.

actions.name: Check Messaging Capability
actions.description: Check whether a recipient can receive iMessage or RCS without sending a message.

actions.name: Connect Payment Handle
actions.description: Start the financial-consent ceremony for a customer phone number or email so an agent can later pay on that customer's behalf.

actions.name: Create Chat
actions.description: Create or reuse a chat on an explicit sending line and send an irreversible recipient-visible initial message.

actions.name: Create Payment
actions.description: Create or advance a real financial payment on a connected customer's behalf, potentially minting a single-use virtual card.

actions.name: Create Payment Request
actions.description: Create a customer-facing checkout that can collect a one-time charge or start an auto-renewing subscription.

actions.name: Create Poll
actions.description: Irreversibly send a recipient-visible iMessage poll to an existing chat.

actions.name: Create Webhook Subscription
actions.description: Create a webhook subscription for selected Linq events at a controlled HTTPS callback.

actions.name: Delete Attachment
actions.description: Permanently delete a Linq attachment and its stored bytes.

actions.name: Delete Message
actions.description: Irreversibly delete a message record from Linq.

actions.name: Delete Webhook Subscription
actions.description: Permanently delete a Linq webhook subscription and stop its future event deliveries.

actions.name: Edit Message
actions.description: Irreversibly change recipient-visible text in one part of a message sent within the last 15 minutes.

actions.name: Get Attachment
actions.description: Return metadata and current status for a Linq attachment referenced by a message.

actions.name: Get Available Number
actions.description: Select an available Linq sending number, optionally for recipients or a line type.

actions.name: Get Chat
actions.description: Return one chat by ID, including participants, service, state, and health information.

actions.name: Get Chat Location
actions.description: Return precise locations currently shared by contacts in a chat.

actions.name: Get Experience
actions.description: Return one Linq experience and preserve its dynamic action field definitions.

actions.name: Get Message
actions.description: Return one Linq message by ID with its content parts, sender, actual and preferred transport, delivery state, reply target, and timestamps.

actions.name: Get Payment
actions.description: Read a payment's financial state, amount, customer handle, merchant details, and any customer-action URL.

actions.name: Get Payment Credentials
actions.description: Return the complete, highly sensitive short-lived handoff used to reveal a ready payment's virtual card directly from the provider.

actions.name: Get Payment Handle Connection
actions.description: Read the financial-consent connection status for a customer phone number or email.

actions.name: Get Payment Provider
actions.description: Read the organization's onboarding status for a payment provider.

actions.name: Get Payment Request
actions.description: Return one payment request's amount, lifecycle status, checkout details, and provider join keys.

actions.name: Get Poll
actions.description: Return an iMessage poll's current options, voters, and distinct voter count.

actions.name: Get Reputation Audit
actions.description: Return a Linq line reputation audit created with explicit approval.

actions.name: Get Webhook Subscription
actions.description: Return one Linq webhook subscription by ID, including its callback URL, event and phone filters, active state, and configured…

actions.name: Leave Chat
actions.description: Leave an iMessage group chat.

actions.name: List Blocked Handles
actions.description: Return phone numbers, email addresses, short codes, and sender IDs currently blocked account-wide from inbound and direct outbound…

actions.name: List Chats
actions.description: Return one page of chats, optionally filtered by sending line or participant, with a cursor for the next page.

actions.name: List Contact Cards
actions.description: Return Linq account contact-card identity data, optionally for one E.164 sending line.

actions.name: List Experiences
actions.description: Discover Linq experiences and their dynamic action fields.

actions.name: List Message Thread
actions.description: Return one page containing the origin message and threaded replies, starting from any message in the thread.

actions.name: List Messages
actions.description: Return one page of messages from a chat, including content, sender, transport, delivery state, direction, reply target, and timestamps,…

actions.name: List Payment Requests
